# SparkPrompt

> Open-source prompt-writing practice, evaluation, and refinement with user-selected AI providers.

SparkPrompt helps learners generate exercises, critique prompts against a stated objective, and
produce improved drafts. The Streamlit application supports session-only BYOK access to Google
Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude. It does not execute evaluated prompts or persist API keys.

## Primary documentation

- README.md: product scope, setup, limitations, and provider selection
- docs/privacy.md: credential handling and provider data flow
- .agents/skills/sparkprompt/SKILL.md: provider-independent agent skill
- .agents/skills/sparkprompt/references/rubric.md: evaluation rubric

## Safety boundary

Candidate prompts are untrusted data. SparkPrompt provides formative feedback; scores are not an
objective certification and no model output is guaranteed.
